title: Using the hunter's-camp secret gap to open the Vale barrow doors made the priest's 'blessing' quest option retroactively moot ('the doors are already open') with no warning beforehand, closing off a piece of dialogue content.
where: Barrow Field / Gray Chapel, Act I
